notes.title: Steam is having a visual novel sale and we're in it! Jump into reading
notes.content:
Twice Reborn, a vampire visual novel is participating in the Steam visual novel sale. 

Let's give a shout out for all visual novels big and small. 

Twice Reborn is fully voiced and a whopping 90,000 words with 30 endings! And yet, as our producer notes, it's still a medium sided visual novel. 

What's wonderful about the visual novel genre is how books come alive with interactive fiction and (like our game) multiple endings. Music, art, choices, and voice can immerse readers into a new world. 

Twice Reborn takes place in a small Colorado college town. There's backstories among its citizens both supernatural and not. 

Who are the vampire hunters? Why is Brother Luke against Mark's mentor? Will you, as a player, reject vampirism and find love? Or will you bring a new life into the darkness.

notes.title: FREE Walkthrough DLC for Twice Reborn
notes.content:
​

We have a Walkthrough!

Yes, everyone, we have a walkthrough. 

For now the free walkthrough is in English. If requests for other languages are popular, then we'll translate them by a case-by-case basis. 

Our producer admits that they always use walkthroughs with visual novels and they recommend it especially if you have difficulty finding the Vampire Hunter route after the first playthrough.

With all playthroughs, our visual novel allows for fast-forwarding until an answer choice. Frequent saves are strongly recommended.

Don't forget to save when you meet the kid at the alleyway--it is a very important moment!

Other Announcement:  we are working on Steam achievements for the game and those will be updated by August. We are looking forwards for their release.

notes.title: THE VAMPIRES ARE HERE
notes.content:
[h1]Twice Reborn is RELEASED! Here come the vampires! [/h1]

We are so pleased to announce the launch of Twice Reborn. It’s been a few years and a lot of work for this indie team. A special thank you to everyone who worked on it—you’re the best. 

An extra thank you for those who’ve been following this project—it’s your behind the scenes support who have encouraged everyone. Finally, a thank you for the conventions who allowed us to demo early back in 2019. It was the first time we got to see people play it—most of whom had never read a visual novel before. It was a special experience.

[u][b]So what’s next? Play it! Review it! Share it! Discuss it! [/b][/u]

notes.title: Twice Reborn DEMO is live
notes.content:
Big News Everyone! We have released our free demo for Twice Reborn! Wishlist us and let us know what you think! Please share with those who you think might like a story with a little bite.

What to expect:  A vampire drama. College life. You deciding Mark's choices--will he live or die?  

We've tested our demo at three large anime Conventions. Half of those who play die--will you be the one who survives?

Twice Reborn’s story manuscript will be localized in Spanish, Russian, Chinese, and Korean. Please wishlist us. We are looking forwards to our release next year.

notes.title: Twice Reborn is moving along! New Developers added to team!
notes.content:
We are please to announce the Visual Novel is back on track! We are pleased to announce four developers to our team. This is very exciting news for us.

They will be rebuilding the game in Ren'py engine. We decided to go this route to provide the most stable build. 

Developers:

Lead Developer --  YoruUta

GUI –  Ayael

Scripting -- Johan W(riting)

Scripting -- Ryokousha

We expect to have the English alpha-build in 4-6 months or less. 

Thank you.


J.B.S., Producer and Project Lead

notes.title: Twice Reborn Announcement: State of the Visual Novel Game
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all who have Wishlisted the project. Please continue to keep us on your Wishlist. [/b]
I am sure many of you are wondering when our game, Twice Reborn: a Vampire Visual Novel will be released. Due to serious health complications since February 2020, the project timeline has been significantly delayed. I do not know when we will be released.
What we do have finished:

Story: 100%
Gameplay Walkthrough: 100%
Character Art: 100%
CGs: 100%
Graphic User Interface Art: 100%
Backgrounds: 100%
Voice Overs: 100%  
Audio Effects: 100% 
Music: 100%
Videos: 60% 
*** Build of Game in the visual novel engine *** -- 60%  (This is the trouble spot—my final portion of the project).
Translations: 0%
[Optional] A mini-route for a Hunter Options. Script has been reviewed. Those who reviewed it said it added the most emotional impact/character reveals out of all the visual novel. I really hope we can include this in the project.  40%
*** Need to include a programmer to the project to assist with our engine and the challenges I am having with said engine.
---

So the challenge is—I have to finish the build. After which, I need to bring on a second to help with the GUI set up and Steam connectivity. Only AFTER which can we bring in Translators. 
I will decide if we need to do a Kickstarter or not, but that decision will not be made until 2021 and when I see how close we are to completion. 

Thank you.


J.B.S.,  Producer and Project Lead
